name: Shelby County, Alabama v. Holder, Attorney General, et al.

court.name: Supreme Court of the United States

parties: Shelby County, Alabama v. Holder, Attorney General, et al.

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Certiorari granted limited to the following question: “Whether Congress’ decision in 2006 to reauthorize §5 of the Voting Rights Act under the pre-existing coverage formula of § 4(b) of the Voting Rights Act exceeded its authority under the Fourteenth and Fifteenth Amendments and thus violated the Tenth Amendment and Article IV of the Constitution.”

casebody.head_matter:
No. 12-96.
Shelby County, Alabama v. Holder, Attorney General, et al.
